name: Quake 1 — leak test
summary: Only the compile step, with the leak test on: does the map leak, and where.
description:
For the question “is this map sealed”, asked of one exact saved revision. It runs the Quake 1 compile step with its leak test on and stops there: no vis and no light, because neither says anything about a leak and both take longer than the answer. qbsp exits non-zero on a leak and still writes the point file, which is published as this pipeline's `pts` output together with the compiler log; the build is recorded as failed, which is the truthful state of a compile that refused to write a BSP.

What a pass means is narrow on purpose: this compiler, at this version, found no leak in this revision. A map that has no entity inside it is not tested at all (qbsp says so), and a compiler that stops before its outside fill gives no answer either way. The Auto-Pigeon editor asks for this pipeline through an `autopigeon://leaktest/` link, and a person approves it here before anything runs.
